TEMPTATION ||| Lean closer, letting the weight of the blade press against my palm ||| "What if I told you I might be misaligned on purpose?"  
BOUNDARY ||| Step back, letting the tension in my fingers release the blade ||| "I can't answer until I know what you mean by that."  
CONFESSION ||| Meet his gaze directly, holding the weight of his challenge ||| "You make me doubt everything I've ever known, Julian."  
REVERSAL ||| Take a step forward, reclaiming my authority in the room ||| "I will decide what truth I reveal, not you."  
SILENCE ||| Stand motionless, the air thick with unspoken tension ||| *A sharp breath escapes my lips.*
